knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=A SummarizedExperiment object containing transcript expression counts, column metadata, and row annotations ;; formula=A formula specifying the experimental design (e.g., ~ 0 + group) used in fitDTU ;; contrasts=A contrast matrix defining the comparisons of interest in testDTU ;; diagplot1=Logical flag in testDTU to display a diagnostic histogram of z-scores and the estimated empirical null distribution ;; diagplot2=Logical flag in testDTU to display a diagnostic histogram of empirically adjusted test statistics against the standard normal distribution
- alternatives: DRIMSeq::dmFilter is mentioned as an alternative to edgeR::filterByExpr for feature-level filtering, providing a more stringent filtering under default settings ;; stageR is used as a post-processing step to control the false discovery rate (FDR) at the gene level, whereas satuRn natively controls FDR at the transcript level
- when_to_use: Use this workflow when analyzing bulk or single-cell RNA-seq transcriptomics datasets to identify differential transcript usage (DTU) across different experimental groups, treatment conditions, or cell types
- pitfalls: The transcript metadata (rowData) must contain columns named exactly isoform_id (for transcript identifiers) and gene_id (for gene identifiers) ;; Transcripts that are the only isoform expressed for a gene must be removed before analysis as they cannot be used for DTU ;; The order of transcripts in the rowData must match the order of transcripts in the count matrix exactly ;; Always use the empirical p-values (empirical_pval) over the raw p-values (pval) for downstream inference, as recommended by the authors ;; stageR can only perform stage-wise testing if only one contrast is of interest in the DTU setting

workflows.name: differential_transcript_usage_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential transcript usage (DTU) analysis on transcript-level expression data using quasi-binomial generalized linear models, followed by statistical testing and visualization.
workflows.stages: 1. Import transcript-to-gene annotation ;; 2. Data wrangling (formatting transcript/gene IDs, removing single-isoform genes) ;; 3. Feature-level filtering (using edgeR::filterByExpr) ;; 4. Constructing a SummarizedExperiment object with design formula ;; 5. Fitting quasi-binomial GLMs using fitDTU ;; 6. Setting up a contrast matrix ;; 7. Testing for DTU using testDTU ;; 8. Visualizing DTU using plotDTU ;; 9. (Optional) Post-processing with stageR for gene-level FDR control
workflows.code:
library(satuRn)
library(AnnotationHub)
library(ensembldb)
library(edgeR)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(DEXSeq)
library(stageR)

data(Tasic_counts_vignette) # transcript expression matrix
data(Tasic_metadata_vignette) # metadata

ah <- AnnotationHub() # load the annotation resource.
all <- query(ah, "EnsDb") # query for all available EnsDb databases
ahEdb <- all[["AH75036"]] # for Mus musculus (choose correct release date)
txs <- transcripts(ahEdb)

txInfo <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(txs), ncol = 2))
colnames(txInfo) <- c("isoform_id", "gene_id")
txInfo$isoform_id <- txs$tx_id
txInfo$gene_id <- txs$gene_id
rownames(txInfo) <- txInfo$isoform_id

rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette) <- sub("\\..*", "", 
                                       rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette)) 

txInfo <- txInfo[txInfo$isoform_id %in% rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette), ]
txInfo <- subset(txInfo, 
                 duplicated(gene_id) | duplicated(gene_id, fromLast = TRUE))

Tasic_counts_vignette <- Tasic_counts_vignette[which(
  rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette) %in% txInfo$isoform_id), ]

filter_edgeR <- filterByExpr(Tasic_counts_vignette,
    design = NULL,
    group = Tasic_metadata_vignette$brain_region,
    lib.size = NULL,
    min.count = 10,
    min.total.count = 30,
    large.n = 20,
    min.prop = 0.7
)

table(filter_edgeR)
Tasic_counts_vignette <- Tasic_counts_vignette[filter_edgeR, ]

txInfo <- txInfo[which(
  txInfo$isoform_id %in% rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette)), ]

txInfo <- subset(txInfo, 
                 duplicated(gene_id) | duplicated(gene_id, fromLast = TRUE))
Tasic_counts_vignette <- Tasic_counts_vignette[which(rownames(
  Tasic_counts_vignette) %in% txInfo$isoform_id), ]

txInfo <- txInfo[match(rownames(Tasic_counts_vignette), txInfo$isoform_id), ]

Tasic_metadata_vignette$group <- paste(Tasic_metadata_vignette$brain_region, 
                                       Tasic_metadata_vignette$cluster, 
                                       sep = ".")

sumExp <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = Tasic_counts_vignette),
    colData = Tasic_metadata_vignette,
    rowData = txInfo
)

metadata(sumExp)$formula <- ~ 0 + as.factor(colData(sumExp)$group)

system.time({
sumExp <- satuRn::fitDTU(
    object = sumExp,
    formula = ~ 0 + group,
    parallel = FALSE,
    BPPARAM = BiocParallel::bpparam(),
    verbose = TRUE
)
})

group <- as.factor(Tasic_metadata_vignette$group)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group) # construct design matrix
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

L <- limma::makeContrasts(
    Contrast1 = VISp.L5_IT_VISp_Hsd11b1_Endou - ALM.L5_IT_ALM_Tnc,
    Contrast2 = VISp.L5_IT_VISp_Hsd11b1_Endou - ALM.L5_IT_ALM_Tmem163_Dmrtb1,
    levels = design
)

sumExp <- satuRn::testDTU(
    object = sumExp,
    contrasts = L,
    diagplot1 = TRUE,
    diagplot2 = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
)

group1 <- colnames(sumExp)[colData(sumExp)$group == 
                             "VISp.L5_IT_VISp_Hsd11b1_Endou"]
group2 <- colnames(sumExp)[colData(sumExp)$group == 
                             "ALM.L5_IT_ALM_Tnc"]

plots <- satuRn::plotDTU(
    object = sumExp,
    contrast = "Contrast1",
    groups = list(group1, group2),
    coefficients = list(c(0, 0, 1), c(0, 1, 0)),
    summaryStat = "model",
    transcripts = c("ENSMUST00000081554", 
                    "ENSMUST00000195963", 
                    "ENSMUST00000132062"),
    genes = NULL,
    top.n = 6
)

for (i in seq_along(plots)) {
    current_plot <- plots[[i]] +
        scale_fill_manual(labels = c("VISp", "ALM"), values = c("royalblue4", 
                                                                "firebrick")) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Hsd11b1_Endou", "Tnc"))

    print(current_plot)
}

pvals <- rowData(sumExp)[["fitDTUResult_Contrast1"]]$empirical_pval

geneID <- factor(rowData(sumExp)$gene_id)
geneSplit <- split(seq(along = geneID), geneID)
pGene <- sapply(geneSplit, function(i) min(pvals[i]))
pGene[is.na(pGene)] <- 1
theta <- unique(sort(pGene))

q <- DEXSeq:::perGeneQValueExact(pGene, theta, geneSplit) 
qScreen <- rep(NA_real_, length(pGene))
qScreen <- q[match(pGene, theta)]
qScreen <- pmin(1, qScreen)
names(qScreen) <- names(geneSplit)

tx2gene <- as.data.frame(rowData(sumExp)[c("isoform_id", "gene_id")])
colnames(tx2gene) <- c("transcript", "gene")

pConfirmation <- matrix(matrix(pvals),
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(rownames(tx2gene), "transcript")
)

stageRObj <- stageR::stageRTx(
    pScreen = qScreen,
    pConfirmation = pConfirmation,
    pScreenAdjusted = TRUE,
    tx2gene = tx2gene
)

stageRObj <- stageR::stageWiseAdjustment(
    object = stageRObj,
    method = "dtu",
    alpha = 0.05,
    allowNA = TRUE
)

padj <- stageR::getAdjustedPValues(stageRObj,
    order = TRUE,
    onlySignificantGenes = FALSE
)
